comment: The class of each tool of ssr that make rebuild-check checks (S1). The copies of kit under scripts/kit are not listed: kit classifies them.

scripts/build-programs.mts.tool: cargo build with its JSON messages, run as the setup script build-programs of cargo-nextest (.config/nextest.toml)

scripts/check-records.mts.reason: the record words, the approved terms, the home paths and the timed assertions that AGENTS.md (Records) states for this repository; no ecosystem linter knows these rules

scripts/fetch-v8.mts.reason: AGENTS.md (Implementation 6): no build downloads V8, and a CI runner fetches the official rusty_v8 archive and binding only after their SHA-256 are verified; the v8 build script downloads without that check

scripts/github-ruleset.mts.tool: gh api, the REST calls of the GitHub CLI, which create the ruleset of .github/ruleset.json and compare it with the live one

scripts/install-packages.mts.reason: Idempotency 2 and 10 of AGENTS.md: the fixture packages and the pinned chromium are installed once per lock digest into an immutable directory that npm ci and playwright-core install fill; no ecosystem tool names an install by the digest of its lock

scripts/verify-archive.mts.reason: AGENTS.md (Implementation 6): the local V8 archive, binding, Cargo features and free disk are verified against declared SHA-256 before linking; the v8 build script reads the archive that RUSTY_V8_ARCHIVE names without checking it
